name: Nebius

source.quote: As of June 30, 2026, the amount of unsatisfied RPO was $37,490.6, of which 36% is expected to be recognized as revenue during the 24 months ending June 30, 2028, 40% between months 25 and 48, and the remainder recognized thereafter.

description: Amsterdam-based AI cloud (spun out of Yandex) that rents Nvidia GPU capacity to Microsoft, Meta and AI developers.
explain: Nebius turned large multi-year contracts from Microsoft and Meta into a fast-growing AI cloud, and Nvidia invested $2 billion in it. Its backlog of contracted revenue is many times its current annual sales.
